name: TPST Services Private Limited
india_angle: We started our Journey in 2022 with an aspiration to serve the semiconductor ecosystem in APAC.
summary: TPST Services Private Limited specializes in semiconductor process, equipment, and manufacturing practices, providing innovative solutions and smart factory technologies to meet customer needs in the APAC region. With over 25 years of experience, they focus on full turnkey projects in the semiconductor industry.
